text: Curd is gathered, kneaded, stretched and tied into skeins; coils weigh 3–4 kg and are soaked in water before eating.

steps.note: Skimmed cow milk; sheep and goat mixes also used.
Soured by warming, or acid whey, sour milk or matsoni is added instead.
With rennet or pepsin, added at 45–50 T for cow milk or 100–110 T for sheep milk.
Until it flakes and sticks into a ribbon.
